overall.verdict: The xln wallet desktop-dark variant demonstrates strong fintech design principles with excellent visceral value implementation, premium dark theme, and clear data hierarchy. The design successfully communicates complex financial concepts through intuitive visualizations while maintaining a calm, professional aesthetic. Key strengths include the one-scale bar system, provable transaction receipts, and consistent component library across screens.
priority_fixes: Standardize amount alignment across all transaction screens for consistent scanning
Improve the visibility and size of critical scale information on home screen
Enhance the prominence of fee displays in payment flows
Increase the size and readability of helper text throughout the interface
Refine the activity screen layout for better transaction scanning
